# NovaPost

## Home

- [Nova Poshta Integration Platform](https://api-portal.novapost.com/land-page.md): Welcome to your team’s developer platform
- [Page 1](https://api-portal.novapost.com/page-1.md)

## Getting Started

- [Integration guide](https://api-portal.novapost.com/novaposhta-docs/integration-guide.md): The Nova Post API provides access to international delivery services and enables you to integrate shipment creation, management, and tracking into your systems.
- [Integration Guide](https://api-portal.novapost.com/novaposhta-docs/integration-guide/integration-guide.md)
- [API Key Generation](https://api-portal.novapost.com/novaposhta-docs/integration-guide/api-key-generation.md)
- [How to generate a JWT token](https://api-portal.novapost.com/novaposhta-docs/integration-guide/how-to-generate-a-jwt-token.md): To send request to the Nova Post API, you must generate a JWT token. The token ensures proper authentication and authorization when executing API requests.
- [How to choose the appropriate endpoint](https://api-portal.novapost.com/novaposhta-docs/integration-guide/how-to-choose-the-appropriate-endpoint.md): Nova Post provides several API endpoints for processing requests related to shipment creation, tracking, and other operations.
- [Using Tokens](https://api-portal.novapost.com/novaposhta-docs/integration-guide/using-tokens.md): The JWT token is a key component of secure interaction with the Nova Post API.
- [API Collections in Postman](https://api-portal.novapost.com/novaposhta-docs/integration-guide/api-collections-in-postman.md): This is a collection of predefined requests for testing API methods, designed to simplify integration and eliminate the need to create requests manually.
- [Testing](https://api-portal.novapost.com/novaposhta-docs/integration-guide/testing.md): Test the API in the sandbox environment before going live. The collection allows safe testing without impacting production.

## API Docs

- [Мethods](https://api-portal.novapost.com/methods/methods.md): The Methods section contains Nova Post API tools for integrating core logistics processes into external systems and automating interaction with delivery services.
- [SDK for PHP](https://api-portal.novapost.com/methods/methods/sdk-for-php.md)
- [Authorization](https://api-portal.novapost.com/methods/methods/authorization.md)

- [Domestic shipments within Ukraine](https://api-portal.novapost.com/methods/methods/shipments/create-shipments/domestic-shipments-within-ukraine.md): This page describes the process of creating shipments within Ukraine.
- [International shipments within Europe](https://api-portal.novapost.com/methods/methods/shipments/create-shipments/international-shipments-within-europe.md): This page describes the process of creating shipments outside of Ukraine. Shipments from Ukraine and to Ukraine are not included.
- [Cross-border shipments to Ukraine](https://api-portal.novapost.com/methods/methods/shipments/create-shipments/cross-border-shipments-to-ukraine.md): This page describes the process of creating shipments from abroad to Ukraine.
- [Cross-border shipments from Ukraine](https://api-portal.novapost.com/methods/methods/shipments/create-shipments/cross-border-shipments-from-ukraine.md): This page describes the process of creating shipments from Ukraine for international delivery.

## Popular Integrations&#x20;

- [Popular integration](https://api-portal.novapost.com/gotovi-integraciyi/popular-integration.md)
- [Base (Baselinker)](https://api-portal.novapost.com/gotovi-integraciyi/popular-integration/base-baselinker.md): Arrange delivery to your store's customers directly through the order management section in Base (Baselinker).
- [Shopify](https://api-portal.novapost.com/gotovi-integraciyi/popular-integration/shopify.md): The app is available regardless of whether you have Shopify Checkout Plus in your subscription. The app supports all rate types: manual, flat, carrier-calculated.
- [Чекліст](https://api-portal.novapost.com/gotovi-integraciyi/popular-integration/cheklist.md)
- [COD (cash on delivery)](https://api-portal.novapost.com/gotovi-integraciyi/popular-integration/cheklist/cod-cash-on-delivery.md): Чекліст допомагає самостійно перевірити, чи коректно налаштована передача параметрів COD в API.
- [Безготівкова оплата](https://api-portal.novapost.com/gotovi-integraciyi/popular-integration/cheklist/bezgotivkova-oplata.md): Чекліст допомагає самостійно перевірити, чи коректно налаштована передача параметрів для безготівкової оплати послуг доставки в API.
- [Відправка на адресу](https://api-portal.novapost.com/gotovi-integraciyi/popular-integration/cheklist/vidpravka-na-adresu.md)
- [Відправка на поштомат](https://api-portal.novapost.com/gotovi-integraciyi/popular-integration/cheklist/vidpravka-na-poshtomat.md)
- [WooCommerce](https://api-portal.novapost.com/gotovi-integraciyi/popular-integration/woocommerce.md): Use the official Nova Post plugin to ensure all services work correctly.
- [PrestaShop](https://api-portal.novapost.com/gotovi-integraciyi/popular-integration/prestashop.md)
- [Magento](https://api-portal.novapost.com/gotovi-integraciyi/popular-integration/magento.md)

## Checklists

- [COD (cash on delivery)](https://api-portal.novapost.com/checklists/cod-cash-on-delivery.md): The checklist helps you independently verify whether COD parameter transmission in the API is configured correctly.
- [Non-cash payment](https://api-portal.novapost.com/checklists/non-cash-payment.md): The checklist helps you independently verify whether the parameters for non-cash payment of delivery services are configured correctly in the API.

# Agent Instructions
This documentation is published with GitBook. GitBook is the documentation platform designed so that both humans and AI agents can read, navigate, and reason over technical content effectively. Learn more at gitbook.com.

## Querying This Documentation
If you need additional information, you can query the documentation dynamically by asking a question.
Perform an HTTP GET request on a page URL with the `ask` query parameter:
```
GET https://api-portal.novapost.com/land-page.md?ask=<question>
```
The question should be specific, self-contained, and written in natural language.
The response will contain a direct answer to the question and relevant excerpts and sources from the documentation.
Use this mechanism when the answer is not explicitly present in the current page, you need clarification or additional context, or you want to retrieve related documentation sections.
